Experience Satta (2003) full movie in stunning 4K quality starring Raveena Tandon and Atul Kulkarni in lead roles. Watch This political thriller on your TV for best experience!
Anuradha relocates to Mumbai where she meets Vivek, an aspiring politician, and marries him. Things take a turn when he is arrested for murder and she has to take his place in the upcoming elections.
Satta is a 2003 Indian Hindi-language political drama film co-written and directed by Madhur Bhandarkar.
